E. A valid arrangement, listed upper/lower, is:
Wall 1: Greene’s watercolor / Franz’s oil
Wall 2: Greene’s oil / Franz’s watercolor
Wall 3: Hidalgo’s oil / Isaacs’s watercolor
Wall 4: Hidalgo’s watercolor / Isaacs’s oil
This satisfies every condition, with both Greene’s and Hidalgo’s paintings in upper positions.
